name: graphics_contour_hist_export
expr: figure; histogram(x, 'FaceColor', [0 0.447 0.741], 'FaceAlpha', 1, 'EdgeColor', [0.851 0.851 0.851]); p = [tempdir 'parity_h.png']; saveas(gcf, p); A = double(imread(p)); h1 = sign(sum(sum(abs(A(:,:,1)) < 20 & abs(A(:,:,2) - 114) < 20 & abs(A(:,:,3) - 189) < 20))); h2 = sign(sum(sum(abs(A(:,:,1) - A(:,:,2)) < 8 & abs(A(:,:,2) - A(:,:,3)) < 8 & A(:,:,1) > 80 & A(:,:,1) < 250))); close all; figure; contour(peaks(10)); p2 = [tempdir 'parity_c.png']; saveas(gcf, p2); A2 = double(imread(p2)); c1 = sign(sum(sum(A2(:,:,3) > A2(:,:,1) + 30))); close all; figure; contourf(peaks(10)); p3 = [tempdir 'parity_cf.png']; saveas(gcf, p3); A3 = double(imread(p3)); c2 = sign(sum(sum(abs(A3(:,:,1) - A3(:,:,2)) > 25 | abs(A3(:,:,2) - A3(:,:,3)) > 25)) - 5000); close all;
comment: contour/contourf/histogram export vs MATLAB R2025b (portion 39). THEME/ALPHA GOTCHA (2026-09-12): histogram default FaceAlpha is 0.6 ALWAYS (not a theme effect) — bars composite with the background (0.6·(0,114,189)+0.4·white = (102,170,215) on light, (7,75,121) on the dark OS theme this install switched to; pinned FaceAlpha=1 renders exact colours under ANY theme — probe-verified 77525 pure-(0,114,189) pixels on dark). nk implements the same semantics: default pre-blends toward white, FaceAlpha NV honoured. Fingerprints: h1 = exact (0,114,189) via the pinned opaque recipe; h2 = neutral-gray edges (predicate — MATLAB edge grey varies with theme); c1/c2 = colormap-driven contour presence (theme-independent). Histogram auto-binning probe-verified: integer rule (x±0.5; Values [2 3 1 0 2 0 0 0 1] — gtest anchor), else Scott 3.5·std·n^(-1/3) floored to 1 significant digit with floor/ceil edges (rand(1,100)→w 0.2; randn(1,1000)→w 0.3/23 bins/−3.3..3.6). Deferred: BinMethod strings, non-count Normalization, histogram(C) — handle-surface-gaps.md.
